clauses.text:
Q2266
Executive Orber.
Mrs. S. Louise Wilkerson, may be appointed to a position in the
classified service of the Government without reference to the civil service
rules.
Mrs. Wilkerson has passed various civil service examinations, and has
been employed as temporary clerk in several of the Executive Depart-
rments. She wvas employed in connection with the work of the Thirteenth
Census from August 10, 11 until December ;31, 191 1, at which time her
services were terminated because of the necessity for reducing LA~e force.
Her record was entirely satisfactory. T'ie Secretary of the Treasury rec-
ommends that an Executive Order be issued authorizing her appointment.
The Civil Service Commission does not concur in the recommendation.
WOODROW WILSON
THlE WHITE HOUSE,
1/ October, 1915.
[No. 2255.]
